summary: Added the five password rules under the password field on the sign-up page. They render as a muted hint list; on submit, every rule the password fails turns red (and submission is blocked before the match/duplicate-email checks). Reading taken: the rules are always visible as guidance, and failing rules become the per-rule errors on submit rather than adding a second duplicated error list.
blockers: Not applied -- Backend enforcement of the same password policy: belongs to the counterpart backend repository
conventions: Passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric)
Password rules are always displayed under the password field; unmet rules are marked in error colour on submit

visual_check.evidence: The signup page shows all five password rules (8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, special character) as a bulleted list directly under the Password field.

context_sharing.notes: There is no HTTP API here: src/pages/Signup.jsx validates locally and persists via src/store.js, which stores users in localStorage under the key 'acme-users' keyed by lowercased trimmed email, and the current session email in sessionStorage under 'acme-current'. The only navigation contract is the client-side routes '/login' (pushed after successful signup) and the '/login' Link; no network endpoints exist to consume.
